_doc: LOCAL autonomous SONZAI hunter -- played by the CODEX CLI planner (your ChatGPT-login subscription, no API key) wearing a Sonzai soul (scripts/agent/soul.sonzai.md, loaded via AGENT_SOUL_FILE). Hierarchical: the planner emits one strategic INTENT every ~20s; the proven rule executor (scripts/agent/agent_brain.mjs) flies the hunter at 20Hz. Runs on YOUR local server (http://localhost:8787) -- no prod realm, no detection. SETUP: npm run db:up && npm run server, then scripts/hunter_agents.sh codex (registers + creates the hunter + loads the soul + launches). MANUAL LAUNCH: CXHUNTER_PASS=... AGENT_PROVIDER=codex AGENT_PLAN=1 AGENT_SOUL_FILE=scripts/agent/soul.sonzai.md node scripts/multibox.mjs scripts/multibox.hunter.codex.json . AGENT_PLAN unset => pure reactive rules; AGENT_SOUL_FILE unset => no persona.
